fact: A study carried out between September 2016 and December 2019 at Omrania family health centre in Giza governorate, with Ministry of Health and Population approval, found that the centre kept its patients' records as paper family files fetched by a clerk and handed to the physician, with very poor technology infrastructure and no connection between its departments, and states that the records of Egypt's family health centres are paper based; the electronic record it describes is a proposed model, not an implemented one.
title: A model for computerization and implementation of electronic health records in Primary health care in Egypt
